values.note: Booked online through the county's ResNexus page or by phone (757-258-5020), up to 1 year ahead and paid in full. At most 90 days in any 120-day period; monthly stays only December-February. Memorial Day and Labor Day weekends take 3 nights. Changes and cancellations by phone with at least 48 hours' notice, less 10%; a 2.95% fee on card payments.
